description: This file defines the EfRepository class, a generic repository implementation for Entity Framework Core within the eShopOnWeb project. It inherits from RepositoryBase and implements IReadRepository and IRepository interfaces, facilitating data access operations for entities implementing IAggregateRoot.

classes.description: A generic repository class for Entity Framework Core, providing data access functionalities for entities.
